name: Duty-Free
summary_paragraphs: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (CSMIA) offers a wide range of tax-free goods, from luxury items to souvenirs.

Discover a wide range of duty-free shops with popular brands, exclusive deals, and great savings.

name: Lounges
headings: Using CSMIA Airport Lounges: What You Need to Know
summary_paragraphs: Passengers departing from CSMIA can wait comfortably at the airport lounges. These lounges offer a peaceful environment with comfortable seating and access to refreshments and other essential facilities.

Lounge is Open for all Walk-In Guests Walk In Charges (as per plans applicable) Children below 3 Yrs are FOC Duration of Lounge Access is limited to 3 Hrs. Maximum We also accept all Major Credit Cards registered under Lounge Access Program issued through Dreamfolks, Priority Pass, Dragon Pass, Amex India, etc.,

Travel Club Lounge is a paid lounge that is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week, and includes a hot and cold buffet with Jain menu options, a paid bar with cocktails and mocktails, free Wi-Fi, newspapers and magazines, telephone calls, printing, a flight monitor, mobile phone charging stations, and a restroom.

Good Times Bar is a paid lounge and bar that is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week, and includes a hot and cold buffet with Jain menu options, a paid bar with cocktails and mocktails, free Wi-Fi, telephone calls, printing, a flight monitor, and mobile phone charging stations.

"The Centurion" is a complimentary lounge and bar for Amex Centurion Charge Card, Platinum Charge Card, and Platinum Corporate and Business cards. It is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week and includes a hot and cold à la carte and buffet menu with Jain menu options, as well as a complimentary bar with cocktails and mocktails. Other amenities include free Wi-Fi, phone calls, printing, a flight monitor, a television, a shoe polish machine, a steam iron, Samsung tablets for work and email, and mobile phone charging stations.

headings: Yellow Fever and Polio Vaccination for Travellers
summary_paragraphs: CSMIA’s Medical Centres are equipped to provide immediate medical assistance to passengers and visitors across the airport premises. The services include first aid, emergency medical response and treatment for non critical medical conditions. Qualified and trained medical professionals are available round the clock to ensure prompt, safe and appropriate medical care.

name: Parking
summary_paragraphs: CSMIA provides safe and accessible parking at both domestic and international terminals, offering short-term and long-term options.

To enhance the travel experience, CSMIA is offering a complimentary pick-up of up to 0-8 minutes (for private vehicles only) at Terminal 1 Designated Arrival Pickup Zone and Terminal 2 Level 5 General Parking (Multi-Level Car Park).
Pre-book your parking slot online and enjoy seamless convenience with our Valet, General, and Premium parking options. Park your vehicle safely by following these easy steps:
Select the package & enter your details
Pay & get parking QR Code on your mobile
Scan the QR Code at the parking counter
The Multi-Level Car Park (MLCP) is a high-rise parking facility with 2,250 spaces, serving both terminals. It has multiple entry and exits points for easy access and is monitored 24/7 for security.
